$comment: Line modules Construct links from their own git repo (linked first, moved later). The source folder is $LINE_SOURCE_DIR, else `default` (~ is the home folder). `commit` pins the source's HEAD; a different HEAD is reported and not loaded unless LINE_LINKS_ALLOW_DRIFT=1. Bump it with `node packages/line-links/link.mjs --pin`.

@mx/seraph.what: seraph's semif: one-letter picks read from a model's first-token probabilities (semanticIf); @mx/reason's jev letters ask through it

@mx/plan.what: the plan API and its tool registry

@mx/morpheus-render.what: Morpheus's isolated page and component render

@mx/morpheus-import.what: Morpheus's import scan; logic verification step 2 (purity.mjs) reads its per-item effect and call facts (scanProgram, scanItems)

@mx/studio-dispatch.what: Studio's tool dispatcher (createDispatcher); cu3 feeds it handlers from Line's tool registry

@mx/studio-editor.what: Studio's Editor parts: Behaviour, Events and States (editor/behaviourView, editor/eventFlow, editor/apiEdits and the EDITOR_WRITES plan edits); cu4 wraps them for Cockpit's Components editor
